Йод.about: Iodine is a trace element for the thyroid gland; in the selection of abstracts there are no positive MA specifically for iodine supplements; there is data on iodine restriction in Hashimoto’s.
Йод.caution: Excess iodine can worsen thyroiditis; for diseases of the thyroid gland - medical supervision; Without a deficiency, supplementation is not justified.
Йод.course: Not established: There is no data on the effectiveness of additives in the abstracts.
Йод.dosage: The dosages of iodine dietary supplements are not given in the abstracts.
Йод.food_sources: Seafood, fish, seaweed, iodized salt, dairy products; Content depends on region and soil.
Йод.guidelines: ESPEN 2022: assessment of status and prescription of microelements for deficiency; SR 2023 (Hashimoto): iodine restriction had no effect; There are no positive MAs for iodine supplements in the selection.
Йод.how_to_choose: Take only with a confirmed deficiency as prescribed by a doctor; dose and form - according to status; for diseases of the thyroid gland - a special scheme.
mechs: supporting thyroid function in case of deficiency

Йод.myths: “More iodine means better thyroid” - in a 2023 review, a diet with iodine restriction did not show any effect. “Everyone needs iodine” - supplementation is logical only if there is an established deficiency. “Iodine is harmless” - excess iodine affects the gland.
